events.title: Intel said it would continue working on the Terafab venture
events.canonical_summary: Intel said it would continue working on Elon Musk’s Terafab chipmaking venture; the report did not disclose terms, scope, timetable or project progress.
events.known_event_summary: On 2026-10-07, Bloomberg’s report, republished by TradingView and cited by Reuters, said Intel would keep working on Elon Musk’s Terafab; no terms or progress were specified.

facts.proposition: Intel said it would continue working on Elon Musk’s Terafab chipmaking venture; the statement did not disclose terms, scope, timetable or progress.

events.title: Musk confirmed TSMC-Terafab talks as Culpium reported stalled Intel collaboration
events.canonical_summary: On 2026-10-03, Culpium reported that Intel's Terafab collaboration was not making progress, a status Intel had not confirmed. Elon Musk publicly confirmed that Terafab was in discussions with TSMC, which Culpium had reported was exploring ways to work with the project.
events.known_event_summary: On 2026-10-03, Culpium reported Intel-Terafab cooperation was not progressing (unconfirmed by Intel), and Musk confirmed Terafab talks with TSMC, which Culpium said was exploring a role.

facts.proposition: Reports said TSMC was targeting or seeking participation in the Terafab project.
Elon Musk confirmed that Terafab, the chip-manufacturing project backed by SpaceX and Tesla, was in discussions with TSMC.
Culpium reported that collaboration with Intel on Terafab was not making progress; Intel had not confirmed the reported status.
